patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..64ec238 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -482,17 +482,28 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         )
         if not admission.accepted:
             if not admission.budget.accepted:
-                state.unresolved_errors.extend(admission.budget.reasons)
-                category = (
-                    "completion_review_budget"
-                    if "completion review budget exhausted" in admission.budget.reasons
-                    else "harness_control"
+                soft_budget_reason = (
+                    "completion checks exceed the remaining environment-call budget"
                 )
-                self._finish(
-                    state,
-                    StopReason.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED,
-                    failure_category=category,
+                terminal_budget_reasons = tuple(
+                    reason
+                    for reason in admission.budget.reasons
+                    if reason != soft_budget_reason
                 )
+                if terminal_budget_reasons:
+                    state.unresolved_errors.extend(terminal_budget_reasons)
+                    category = (
+                        "completion_review_budget"
+                        if "completion review budget exhausted" in terminal_budget_reasons
+                        else "harness_control"
+                    )
+                    self._finish(
+                        state,
+                        StopReason.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED,
+                        failure_category=category,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self._reject_completion(state, admission.reasons, contract)
             else:
                 self._reject_completion(state, admission.reasons, contract)
             return
